scope: All 165 live v019 Latin prěd-/pred-polag-, -poklad-, and -polož- assumption-family tokens; 107 noncanonical or source-shaped forms changed.
choice: Use official prědpoklad- for the imperfective assume/presume family and official prědpolož- for its perfective, passive, adjectival, and supposition-noun family. Preserve each suffix, aspect, case, number, gender, and initial capitalization.
motivation: The live edition mixed four shapes for one mathematical assumption family, including unaccented pred- and the East-shaped polag- doublet. The 44-book portion already used prědpoklad- consistently for the imperfective verb. Official type-1 prědpokladati and prědpoložiti/prědpoloženje provide a coherent edition-wide split without changing meaning or syntax.
alternatives_rejected: Retain pred- spellings: they violate the edition's accepted prěd- orthography and leave an accidental cross-file doublet.
Retain prědpolag- as a parallel official variant: it is grammatical, but preserving both it and prědpoklad- would keep an unnecessary East-shaped inconsistency in a single edition.
Replace every prědpolož- form with prědpoklad-: that would destroy the official perfective, passive, adjectival, and noun family and its aspectual distinctions.

entries: id 3130 prědpokladati, transitive imperfective type 1, assume/suppose/presume/take for granted
id 20062 prědpolagati, grammatical doublet rejected only for edition-level canonical consistency
